rules.text: Standard return window is 30 days for purchases outside the holiday extended period.
rules.quote: For all other countries, our standard 30 day return and exchange policy applies.

rules.text: Returns are only accepted for orders purchased directly from On.
rules.quote: We are only able to accept returns for orders purchased directly from On.

rules.text: On is unable to accept returns of products purchased from retail partners.
rules.quote: On is unable to accept the return of product purchased from one of our retail partners.

rules.category: limited editions and last season items
rules.text: Limited editions and last season items can only be refunded, not exchanged.
rules.quote: Limited editions and last season items can only be refunded, but are not exchangeable due to limited stock.

rules.text: Expedited shipping costs on the original order are not refunded.
rules.quote: Please note that expedited shipping costs on the original outbound order will not be refunded in the case of returns or exchanges.

rules.text: Return shipping is free for eligible returns except in India, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia.
rules.quote: We offer free return shipping for eligible returns unless you are in India, Indonesia, Thailand or Malaysia.

rules.text: Gift returns require the original order number and gift receipt in the US.
rules.quote: In the US, we ask that you provide the gift receipt that was sent in the Shipping Confirmation email of the original order.

rules.text: Exchanges are allowed only for different sizes or colors of the same model if in stock.
rules.quote: We allow for exchanges for a different size or color of the same model as originally purchased. The new size and color must be in stock to be able to proceed with the exchange.

rules.category: limited editions and last season items
rules.text: Limited edition and last season items are not exchangeable but can be returned for a refund.
rules.quote: Limited edition products and colorways plus Last Season pieces are not exchangeable but can be returned for a refund.
